svg.aria-label: Bode plot of G(s) = (2s + 1)/s, a gain of 2 in parallel with an integrator: the magnitude falls at 20 dB per decade, passes 9 dB at omega = 0.5 and levels off at 6 dB; the phase rises from minus 90 to 0 degrees, passing minus 45 at the corner 0.5 rad/s
